children: TruGolf entered into a Separation and Settlement Agreement with Christopher Jones that restructures a $1.44 million insider demand loan and outlines a $500,000 repurchase of certain franchise rights. The loan will shift from payable-on-demand to a 12-month maturity, with 10% of principal due by the Initial Payment Date and 90% due at maturity, accruing 12% simple interest with monthly payments. The franchise rights buyback similarly provides 10% upfront and 90% deferred for 12 months at 12% interest, subject to acceleration if the rights are resold. The arrangements enhance liquidity predictability and consolidate franchise assets following Jones’s departure.
